clips.title: The story
paras: In Stormwind, The Slaughtered Lamb gives gnome warlocks a place to seek training. With King Magni Bronzebeard watching dark practitioners in Ironforge, mentors send their students to human warlocks for instruction.

Before Gnomeregan fell, aspiring warlocks in Khaz Modan studied with tinker-mages and demonic scholars inside the techno-city. The disaster scattered those institutions and drove the gnomes into exile. Surviving practitioners crowded into Ironforge's underground caverns, watched by King Magni Bronzebeard and the dwarven guard. They cannot openly practice demonic arts or perform dangerous rituals there, so senior instructors such as Lago Blackwrench send students away.

Gnome students sent south from Ironforge seek instruction at the Slaughtered Lamb, a tavern in Stormwind's Mage Quarter. Twisting stone passages and stairs lead from its taproom to a hidden sanctum where human warlocks gather. Gakin the Darkbinder oversees the covert gathering. Its space and dark paraphernalia let instructors teach novices to summon and bind minor demons without drawing the immediate anger of the city marshals.

Stormwind's coven welcomes capable hands, but the arrival of refugee novices brings friction. Human mentors already risk discovery by the city's paladins and authorities. Gakin and his colleagues find their hidden sanctuary more crowded as practitioners arrive from Khaz Modan. The steady stream from the dwarven mountain could expose their discreet operation, yet neither the gnomes nor the human warlocks have an easier choice.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Hmph. Times past, all warlocks in Khaz Modan were trained under the auspices of the masters of Gnomeregan, but now that we've all been forced to relocate into this rat's hole in Ironforge, and Magni's decided to keep a careful watch on us, we're forced to send our novices to Stormwind for training.
Luckily, Gakin's no slouch, so you'll still learn what you need to know, but it burns my blood!
Anyways, you'll find Gakin in the basement of the Slaughtered Lamb in Stormwind.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Sent by Blackwrench, were you? Damn warlocks in Ironforge need to get things sorted out. There's only so much room and so many teachers in Stormwind. With all the increased traffic, we're sure to attract attention sooner or later.
